name: Verde River (Clarkdale - Cottonwood)
blurb: Short flatwater-to-riffle floats on the Verde River Greenway and Prescott NF access sites between Clarkdale and Camp Verde. Irrigation diversion dams, sweepers and strainers.

sections.takeOut: Dead Horse Ranch State Park River Day Use Area (Verde)
sections.notes: AZ State Parks Paddle Map 1: Mile 0.0 Tuzigoot Bridge to Mile 3.0 Dead Horse Ranch River Day Use Area. Two diversion dams: Hickey Ditch Diversion Dam (Mile 0.25) and Cottonwood Ditch Diversion Dam (Mile 0.8), scout on river left. Clarkdale: below the Cottonwood Ditch boaters 'will face many areas where portage is required'; the ditch can take the entire river at times. AZSP: watch for 'sleepers and strainers'.

Prescott NF: 'a short, smooth water float from Black Canyon River Access Point'. AZ State Parks Paddle Map 3 table: Black Canyon (RM 23) 1.0 mile to Bignotti (RM 24). Do not continue below Bignotti: the water is 'generally too shallow and has too many obstacles for boating down river between Bignottie and White Bridge' (Prescott NF).

guideTimes.conditions: Guide lists 1 hour at low flow and 0.5 hour at medium flow for 1 mile. Numeric flow bands, craft and stops are not specified in this table.
guideTimes.sourceName: Arizona State Parks-hosted Verde River Paddle Map 3, page 3 (2013 guide)

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
